title: Gearball
tagline: Unlock the gates in time and move the socket under the electric marble

fr.tagline: Voici un jeu frénétique où une machine infernale ne s'arrête jamais ! Entretenez le flux en libérant des barrières sur le fil du rasoir et anticipez les trajectoires pour capturer la précieuse bille électrique. Avec plusieurs dizaines de cartes d'amélioration et des décors mécaniques envoûtants, chaque seconde exige réflexes et précision. Êtes-vous prêt à dompter la machine ?

en.tagline: A frantic game where an infernal machine never stops! Keep the flow going by releasing gates right on the razor's edge and anticipate trajectories to catch the precious electric marble. With dozens of upgrade cards and enchanting mechanical settings, every second demands reflexes and precision. Are you ready to tame the machine?

description: A marble machine in portrait, and the player keeps it running. A start gear turning half off the screen pours marbles onto chrome rails with real slope physics: they pick up speed downhill, slow on the flat and crawl over the top of a loop, through flip-flop switches, the Dynamo (a notched wheel that merges lines), zigzags, corkscrews, coils, whirlpools that drain through their centre, glass tubes, pipes that dive behind the machine and resurface, ferry gears that carry a marble round their rim from one line to the next, striped zebra tubes it flickers through, dark accordion hoses, ski jumps that throw it into a catcher, staircases that ring a note at every ledge, humps and copper boosters, into glowing arrivals at the bottom, each known by its colour. Every loop, spiral, jump, booster and staircase a marble rides pays a few points, floating up where they are won. What they swallow drops to a gutter and rides a screw tower up the back of the machine to the start gear, so the pour never runs dry. The Combo on the Dynamo's hub multiplies every point, x1, x2, x3 and up with no top, and only the player feeds it: every gate opened sends a spark per released marble flying to the hub, each lighting a notch of its gauge, every electric marble caught lights five, and ten notches lit raise the Combo by one. The Dynamo's voltage, a ring round it, drops while a gate stays locked and comes back up with every gate opened or electric marble caught — let it run out and the Combo drops by one. The bigger it grows, the louder the machine gets: trails, sparks and arcs between the marbles, lit rails, a glowing frame, and a big combo breaks in slow motion. The gates are open until one LOCKS, at random and more and more often: a locked gate holds its marbles in slots that fill green to red and shows a big pulsing padlock, and a tap opens it. A marble that reaches a full locked gate (the Combo is spared: the voltage already punishes it) drops through a trapdoor behind the machine, where a spill network of back rails and turning cogs carries it to a red socket that costs a heart. One ELECTRIC marble is always in play, and one arrival is its socket: a switch flips only once the electric marble has passed it, so the player reads its whole route as it sets off and taps an arrival to move the socket under it. Caught, the electric marble pays big, sends an arc up the rails to the Dynamo and lights five notches — anywhere else it fizzles, the combo breaks and the machine's lights go out for half a second. The machine changes with every level: thirty machines in five biomes, each its own skeleton, from one switch and two arrivals to six switches, six gates and six arrivals.

pitch: Marbles pour onto chrome rails, race through loops, spirals and tubes, and fall into glowing arrivals. You are the one who keeps it all moving.
Open the gates in time, follow the electric marble and send your Combo through the roof.

sections.title: A living machine
text: Every loop, spiral, jump and booster pays a few points, and every staircase rings a note at each ledge.
Thirty machines in five biomes, from one switch and two arrivals to six switches, six gates and six arrivals.

sections.title: Chase the spark
text: Gates lock at random. Tap one to open it, and the Dynamo lights up.
One marble is electric, and you can always follow it. Tap an arrival to move the blue socket under it, and every point you score is multiplied by a Combo with no top.

sections.title: Pick an upgrade
text: Catch the electric marble at a charged socket and the machine pauses to deal you two upgrade cards.
Pick one. It might help you, add points, or bring a bonus with a risk.
list: won on the map or out of the gumball machine.

en.outro: Press Run game, watch the marbles pour and keep the machine running.

fr.tagline: Attrape toujours les billes électriques et déverrouille les mécanismes

strings.Each marble that reaches an arrival scor:
Chaque bille atteignant une arrivée rapporte des points multipliés par le Combo.

Au clavier, la touche 'Espace' décale l'arrivée électrique d'un cran, de gauche à droite de manière cyclique.
strings.Gates lock at random. Tap the padlock to:
Les barrières se verrouillent au hasard : touche leur cadenas pour les débloquer.

Chaque bille libérée d'une barrière allume un cran de la Dynamo.
Touche une arrivée pour l'activer. Seule l'arrivée bleue peut capturer une bille électrique.

La bille électrique casse le Combo si elle n'est pas récupérée par une arrivée électrique.
strings.When a queue is full, the next marble dr:
Lorsqu'une file est pleine, la bille suivante tombe par la trappe.

Une bille qui roule vers l'arrivée rouge fait perdre un cœur.
strings.The Combo multiplies every point you sco:
Le Combo multiplie tous tes points. Quand tous les crans de la Dynamo sont allumés, le Combo s'incrémente de 1.

Rater une bille électrique ramène le Combo à x1.
strings.The outer ring of the Dynamo shows its v:
L'anneau extérieur de la Dynamo indique sa tension. Cette tension baisse lorsqu'une barrière reste verrouillée.

La tension remonte à son maximum lorsqu'une barrière s'ouvre ou qu'une bille électrique est capturée.

Si la tension tombe à zéro, le Combo diminue de 1.
strings.When the blue socket is fully charged, c:
Lorsque l'arrivée bleue est complètement chargée, capturer une bille électrique met la machine en pause et propose deux cartes d'amélioration.

Choisis la meilleure carte. L'une t'aide, l'autre augmente tes points et parfois un bonus s'accompagne d'un risque.
strings.Marbles stay visible in a glass tube, pa:
Les billes restent visibles dans un tube de verre, partiellement visibles dans un tube rayé et masquées dans un soufflet.

La bille électrique reste toujours visible même à travers des conduits.
strings.A whirlpool spirals the marble down its:
Un tourbillon entraine la bille jusqu'à son siphon.

Une voie qui plonge passe sous les autres et ressort par l'embouchure d'un tuyau.
